title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Jago Winkleholt · August 2025
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Rowan Bell called Jago Winkleholt for an August check-in.

Jago said the car seat drive wrapped up. They got seven. All gently used, all passed the safety check. It’s already made a difference—they transported three more little ones to their shots last week without having to turn anyone away.
Rowan asked about how the network could help spread word for future drives.
Jago said maybe a note in the newsletter when they run low again. He sounded tired but pleased. Said it’s one less thing for families to worry about.
Rowan shifted to ask if Jago had heard any updates from others in the Quadling Health Access circle.

Jago mentioned he’d heard something nice about Emrys Crowham from a South Copse staffer. Said the staffer told him Emrys makes sure every single resident gets a birthday card and gets to pick their dessert at lunch, even the ones who don’t get visitors. It’s not a big announcement, just something Emrys does.
Rowan noted that as hearsay from staff, via Jago.

Jago also brought up Honor Tinford, unprompted. Said he eats at The Tinford Table sometimes after long shifts. Heard from Honor directly last week that the walk-in cooler door hinge gave out. Instead of replacing the whole door, Honor tracked down the exact hinge at some specialist hardware place over in Brickway. Saved a bundle, she said. Place stayed open.
Rowan confirmed that was a done thing, and thanked Jago for the update.
Jago ended by saying the transport schedule is fuller than ever, and he’s looking at a possible partnership with a Meadow Mutual Aid driver for longer trips, but it’s just an idea for now.
